findings_and_questions.classification: source-backed conditional plan aggregate admission gap
findings_and_questions.mechanism: BuildingPlan and ResolvedGeometry have public, deserializable collections and WallAssembly.host_solids exposes selected IDs. compile_building_collision collects solids into a BTreeMap by ID, which keeps the last value for a duplicate, gathers selected IDs from wall and other owners, and uses filter_map to look them up. A selected ID missing from the solids map is silently skipped; if two solids share an ID, selection resolves to the last rather than a uniquely established physical member. If the rest of compilation succeeds, returned collision may omit the referenced solid or use the wrong member. Tactical collision compiles the resulting cuboids into its compound.
findings_and_questions.qualification: Separate audit_resolved_geometry checks duplicate solid IDs and other provenance, but this compile entry does not call it. Missing reference/duplicate cases require a direct or decoded/mutated incoherent plan and all other required compilation paths to succeed. Actual generated/accepted upstream graphs and native physics were not exercised; no ordinary production omission or severity inferred. Distinguish intentional repeated CollisionCuboid.source values for arch strips and distinct semantic components from duplicate ResolvedSolid IDs.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Define the accepted-plan boundary and enforce each required selected reference and unique resolved identity there, preserving excluded replaced walls, gables, apertures and deliberate optional modes. Carry source/owner context in a typed failure; no repair now.

findings_and_questions.mechanism: BuildingCollision independently retains public bounds and cuboid vector and derives Deserialize; SpatialBounds and each cuboid are checked individually, but these source declarations impose no relationship between them. Normal compilation recomputes the union of plan footprint and each cuboid bound. A caller subsequently mutating or decoding a different valid bounds centre changes the architectural origin used to recenter the native compound and to project placement; a bounds/cuboid aggregate can therefore be internally incoherent without leaf validation rejecting it.
findings_and_questions.qualification: GeneratedBuildingRecipe::generate builds plan and collision together; this is not a claim that ordinary generation is stale, or that rendering and physics necessarily disagree when both use the same supplied origin. Actual cache/deserialize/mutation producers and projection/native consumer policy remain open. Separate 059 Q-L12-5cc02ecd5125d414e1f4 concerns wider program/plan/collision consistency; preserve as connected, not identical by assumption.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: At a responsible accepted aggregate boundary, recompute or prove the precise bounds/cuboids/footprint relationship needed by placement; preserve intentional footprint fallback and numerical rounding policy. Avoid blanket rejection of legitimate zero-extent contact.

findings_and_questions.classification: mathematically demonstrated conditional source attribution collision
findings_and_questions.mechanism: For each opening and bar ordinal, compile_window_bars constructs source = (7<<60) | (opening_id<<8) | ordinal. OpeningAssemblyId is a public u64 wrapper. For two IDs 1 and 1+(1<<52), bit52 shifts into tag bit60 already set by 7<<60; with the same ordinal both source words are identical. WindowBarSpec keeps opening and source separately, but collision compilation retains only source in each resulting cuboid and in source-keyed CollisionError.
findings_and_questions.qualification: Two physically distinct bars are appended independently; no physical collision omission or actual producer collision is established. The case requires admitted openings with those IDs and same bar ordinal, and actual generated ID range/reserved-bit rules and consumers of source identity remain untraced. Historical gate/roof ID-domain questions are conceptually related, not proved aliases.
findings_and_questions.future_direction: Trace the generating namespace and receivers; if source identity must be injective across admitted openings and member roles, use an explicitly checked encoding or structured identity preserving opening and ordinal at that boundary.

nonfindings: Ground-contact classification uses computed corners and edges, not the separately rounded placement AABB; it preserves distinct Empty/Point/Segment/Area and propagates construction causes. The source’s rounding regression is test intent only, not executed evidence.
CuboidDimensions explicitly admits finite nonnegative axes, including zero and degenerate shapes; no blanket strictly-positive requirement follows for the generic type.
CollisionCuboid::corners and bounds check computed output and retain the source identity in geometry errors; admitted finite leaves alone do not guarantee all arithmetic succeeds.
Eight sign codes and twelve fixed undirected edges are intrinsic cuboid topology, not arbitrary semantic magic numbers.
All source tests were inspected as text only; no test, fixture, generator, product, build, viewer, geometry or runtime probe was run.
